attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: league_management
steps:
  - id: receive_league_form
    op: receive_form_submission
    params:
      source: league_create_update_form
      required_fields:
        - league_name
        - display_properties
        - action_type
    output: league_form_data

  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      user_id: "{{ league_form_data.admin_user_id }}"
      required_role: admin
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_league_name_unique
    op: check_uniqueness
    params:
      table: leagues
      field: name
      value: "{{ league_form_data.league_name }}"
      exclude_id: "{{ league_form_data.league_id | default(null) }}"
    output: uniqueness_check

  - id: fail_if_name_not_unique
    op: assert_condition
    params:
      condition: "{{ uniqueness_check.is_unique == true }}"
      error_message: "League name '{{ league_form_data.league_name }}' already exists. Please choose a unique name."

  - id: check_active_references_on_update
    op: conditional
    params:
      condition: "{{ league_form_data.action_type == 'update' }}"
      steps:
        - id: verify_no_destructive_changes
          op: check_references
          params:
            table: leagues
            record_id: "{{ league_form_data.league_id }}"
            referenced_by:
              - table: teams
                foreign_key: league_id
              - table: games
                foreign_key: league_id
            prevent_delete_if_active: true
          output: reference_check

  - id: upsert_league_record
    op: upsert_record
    params:
      table: leagues
      action: "{{ league_form_data.action_type }}"
      record_id: "{{ league_form_data.league_id | default(null) }}"
      data:
        name: "{{ league_form_data.league_name }}"
        display_properties: "{{ league_form_data.display_properties }}"
        updated_by: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
        updated_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output: league_record

  - id: notify_admin_success
    op: send_notification
    params:
      recipient: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
      channel: in_app
      message: "League '{{ league_record.name }}' has been successfully {{ league_form_data.action_type }}d."
